crossRefs.note: But you followed my teaching, conduct, purpose, faith, patience, love, steadfastness,
“I am indeed a Jew, born in Tarsus of Cilicia, but brought up in this city at the feet of Gamaliel, instructed…

people.name: Jerusalem
people.line: The capital of Israel, a holy city for three religions

translations.web: “Indeed, all the Jews know my way of life from my youth up, which was from the beginning among my own nation and at Jerusalem;
translations.bsb: Surely all the Jews know how I have lived from my earliest childhood among my own people, and also in Jerusalem.
translations.kjv: My manner of life from my youth, which was at the first among mine own nation at Jerusalem, know all the Jews;
translations.asv: My manner of life then from my youth up, which was from the beginning among mine own nation and at Jerusalem, know all the Jews;
